retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant 1970s-inspired pop portrait featuring a central figure in studded leather against a circular rainbow and neon background with arched display typography.
triggerTerms: circular rainbow border with path text
excludeWhen: flat vector illustrations without photographic elements

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a person viewed from the back/side, wearing a black leather outfit heavily embellished with colorful rhinestones and gold rope-like lettering. The subject is framed by a large pink circular halo, which is itself bordered by a multi-colored concentric rainbow ring. The outer background is a vibrant lime green, featuring bold, arched 70s-style display text at the top and fine metadata text following the circular path of the rainbow.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric circular framing elements (pink circle, rainbow ring, text path)
Contrast between matte lime green background and glossy black leather
Repetition of rhinestone textures across the jacket and pants
Symmetry in the outer layout vs. asymmetrical pose of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, waist-up to full-body, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The rhinestone lettering on the back of the jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top display text, follows the rainbow circle downward, and settles on the subject's back and profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-saturation lime green corners and pink inner circle provide breathing room for the busy textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Lime green (outer background) and Pink (inner circle).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (leather outfit) providing a dark anchor.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Rainbow spectrum (orange, blue, green) and gold (lettering).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout; neon-adjacent palette with high-key lighting on the subject.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between subject and background

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with rounded corners
Inner drop-shadow or offset effect to create depth
Arched baseline following the top curve of the circle
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are squeezed slightly to fit the arc
Rhinestone-like texture applied to the jacket lettering
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, expressive display type paired with functional, clean path-based metadata.

avoid: Script fonts for the display text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s flared aesthetic and weight
Classic bubble serif foundation for the display text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a person from the back wearing a black leather jacket with colorful rhinestone patterns. Place them inside a pink circle, surrounded by a thin multi-colored rainbow ring, all on a lime green background. Leave the top area and the rainbow ring clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, arched 70s bubble-serif text at the top in orange. Add small black sans-serif text following the inner curve of the rainbow ring.

verificationChecks: Is the display text arched correctly?
Does the metadata text follow the circular path?
Are the rhinestones visible and colorful?
Is the lime green background vibrant?

adjustableVariables: Density of rhinestones on the jacket
Number of colors in the rainbow ring
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific song titles in the path text

avoid: Overlapping text that obscures the subject's face

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility on the circular path
Ensure the rainbow ring is perfectly concentric
Verify the rhinestone texture looks like physical embellishments
Confirm the 70s aesthetic is maintained through color and type
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in [Material] + [Embellishment] + [Circular Frame] + [Rainbow Border] + [Arched Bubble Type]
